title: Phoneme-identity depth profiles do not reliably predict LoRA placement for dysarthric ASR
abstract: arXiv:2611.32455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parameter-efficient adaptation of a speech foundation model to dysarthric speech requires a rarely justified choice: which encoder layers to adapt. A recently proposed strategy is to probe the encoder, find where phonetic information becomes most decodable, and put the adapters there. We test that inference across two ASR models (Qwen3-ASR, Whisper-small) and two dysarthric corpora (Mandarin CDSD, English UASpeech), holding recipe and seed discipline constant.   The inference fails. Measured under one pipeline rather than inherited from published figures, all four phoneme-error curves minimise between 83% and 92% of relative depth, each model's minimising layer moving no further between corpora than between probe seeds. The best adaptation band is not similarly constant: none of three natural mappings from the curve to a band -- steepest improvement, lowest band-mean error, or knee location -- recovers the best tested configuration. translated_title: 音素身份深度剖面无法可靠预测构音障碍语音识别中LoRA的放置位置
translated_abstract: 将语音基础模型参数高效地适配到构音障碍语音时，需要做出一个很少被充分论证的选择：应该适配哪些编码器层。最近提出的一种策略是探测编码器，找出语音（音素）信息最可解码的深度位置，并将适配器放置在那里。我们在两个ASR模型（Qwen3-ASR、Whisper-small）和两个构音障碍语料库（中文CDSD、英文UASpeech）上测试了这一推断，同时保持训练配方和随机种子纪律一致。该推断被证明是失败的。在统一流水线下测量（而非继承自已发表的数据），所有四条音素错误曲线均在相对深度的83%至92%之间达到最小值，且每个模型的最小化层在语料库之间的变化幅度不超过探测种子之间的变化幅度。然而最佳适配带并非同样恒定：从音素错误曲线到适配带的三种自然映射方式——最陡改进位置、最低带均值错误或拐点位置——没有一个能够恢复出最佳测试配置。
tldr: 本研究通过在两个ASR模型和两个构音障碍语料库上的统一受控实验证明，基于音素可解码性深度剖面来选择LoRA适配器放置位置的方法并不可靠，音素错误曲线的最小值位置虽然相对稳定，但无法有效指导最佳适配带的选择。
